name: Casifier
description: Casifier wraps movie primary posters in DVD, Blu-ray, and Ultra HD case artwork based on video resolution. It can run on a schedule and after Jellyfin library scans.
overview: Generate media-case posters for Jellyfin movies.

versions.changelog: Fixes the Movie Versions page error 't.toLowerCase is not a function' on Jellyfin 12, keeps the 'Deleted ...' message visible after a delete, and removes a stray 'null' from the summary. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer.
